summary: Strengthen mining safety and hazard management skills with practical tools and case-based training. Enroll your team to reduce incidents and stabilize operation
lede: Mining safety management helps professionals identify and control hazards across underground and surface operations. This course is for mine safety officers, supervisors, operations managers, and engineers responsible for safe work practices. Participants practice assessing risks, building BowTie models for major hazards, and developing atmospheric monitoring, ventilation, machinery isolation, and permit-to-work procedures.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals responsible for the design, implementation, and oversight of safety protocols in both underground and surface mining operations.
modules: Advanced Risk Assessment and BowTie Modeling
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2-3 years of experience in a mining or heavy industrial environment. A basic understanding of occupational health and safety principles is required. No prior experience with ISO 45001 or BowTie modeling is necessary, as these will be taught during the course. Participants are encouraged to bring a laptop for risk modeling exercises.
